Because raw_transactions has 5165 rows but only 4827 distinct txn_ids, the duplicates also double-count amounts in every gold table, so silver must parse both timestamp formats and keep one row per txn_id.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH ranked AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) ORDER BY ingest_ts, batch_id) AS rn FROM raw_transactions), parsed AS (SELECT *, COALESCE(TRY_CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP), epoch_ms(TRY_CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT))) AS ts FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1) SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, ts AS txn_ts, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM parsed WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
